description:
Make a gate evaluation resolve its checker documents and repository validation from the evaluation's own captured image, so evidence and discovery are one set.

## Background

- Checker documents are rediscovered with fresh declarations and directory listings (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs` ~405, reached from `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs` ~1336), while the evaluation's evidence capture covers only explicit documents (`gate_check.rs` ~443).
- Repository validation inside an evaluation recaptures independently (`gate_check.rs` ~1111).
- Story `d675102c` sol checkpoint review, finding 3. Invoker ruling: narrowed to REQ-12's wording.
- Out of scope (steward ruling): verdict digests that read live files (`gate_check.rs` ~920, `crates/jit/src/gate_execution.rs` ~410). An exec checker runs on the working tree, so its digest must fingerprint the live inputs it consumes.
- Epic criterion: `b697a3f7` REQ-12 (each evaluation resolves its inputs once per captured image).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Checker document discovery for a gate evaluation takes its declarations and directory listings from the evaluation's captured image, through the same capture as its evidence, so the evidence covers every document discovery returns.
- [hard] REQ-02: Repository validation inside a gate evaluation reads the evaluation's captured image and opens no second capture.
- [hard] REQ-03: Verdict digests are unchanged, and behaviour of gate evaluation is otherwise unchanged.
title: A gate evaluation resolves checker documents and validation from its own captured image
